validated_patterns.name: multi_line_import_preservation

fix.implementation: DO NOT modify imports already using correct parenthesis format

validated_patterns.notes: Wave 10 manually fixed by preserving Python's standard multi-line import format

validated_patterns.name: constant_import_from_base

fix.implementation: Import actual constants defined in src/constants/base.py

validated_patterns.notes: Replaced hardcoded values with semantic constants from base module

validated_patterns.name: function_call_multi_line_args

detection.pattern_description: Function calls with multi-line arguments properly indented

fix.implementation: Maintain 4-space indentation for continuation lines inside parentheses

validated_patterns.notes: PEP 8 compliant indentation preserved in Wave 10 fixes

validated_patterns.name: async_function_with_await

fix.implementation: All functions using 'await' must be declared as 'async def'
fix.code_example_after:
async def test_function():
    result = await async_operation()

validated_patterns.notes: All async patterns correctly implemented with @pytest.mark.asyncio decorators

detection.pattern_description: Module and function docstrings with triple quotes

fix.implementation: Maintain opening and closing triple quotes on separate lines for multi-line docstrings
fix.code_example_after:
UNCHANGED - single line docstrings are valid
OR
"""
Multi-line docstring
with proper formatting
"""

validated_patterns.name: pytest_fixture_scope

detection.pattern_description: Pytest fixture decorators with proper scope parameters

fix.implementation: Session scope for expensive setup, function scope for test isolation

validated_patterns.notes: Proper fixture scoping for performance and test isolation

validated_patterns.name: raw_string_windows_paths

fix.implementation: Prefix Windows paths with r'' or use forward slashes
fix.code_example_after:
path = r"C:\Users\test\file.txt"  # Raw string
OR
path = "C:/Users/test/file.txt"  # Forward slashes

validated_patterns.notes: All Windows path literals properly escaped

anti_patterns.name: bracket_harmonizer_overmatch
anti_patterns.problem: Regex matched VALID multi-line imports as broken syntax
anti_patterns.lesson: Cannot use regex to 'fix' Python syntax - must use AST parsing to distinguish valid from invalid
anti_patterns.prevention: Use ast.parse() to validate before attempting 'fix', skip files that parse successfully

anti_patterns.name: indentation_reconstructor_overzealous
anti_patterns.lesson: Indentation 'fixes' should only apply to lines with clear errors (mixing tabs/spaces, inconsistent depth)
anti_patterns.prevention: Validate each line's indentation against previous line context, not absolute patterns

anti_patterns.name: auto_formatter_interference
anti_patterns.problem: VS Code Python formatter ran during agent execution, removing closing braces
anti_patterns.timing: Immediately after file write, before agent validation
anti_patterns.lesson: Disable all auto-formatters before systematic bulk repairs

anti_patterns.name: semantic_corruption_out_of_scope
anti_patterns.problem: Import statements replaced constants with numeric literals
anti_patterns.root_cause: Earlier automated refactoring tool cascade failure
anti_patterns.lesson: Regex patterns cannot fix semantic corruption - requires manual reconstruction or git restore
anti_patterns.remediation: git show <old-commit>:<file> to restore original imports OR infer from constant usage context

anti_patterns.name: no_baseline_protection
anti_patterns.problem: Working files from Wave 10 were not protected from modification
anti_patterns.impact: Lost all test discovery progress (111 → 0 tests)
anti_patterns.lesson: Create .fixignore file with successfully validated files before bulk operations

prevention.fixignore_example:
# Files passing ast.parse() - do not modify
tests/phase7_adas/__init__.py
tests/phase7_adas/conftest.py
tests/phase7_adas/test_sensor_fusion.py
tests/phase7_adas/test_perception_accuracy.py

anti_patterns.name: single_pass_insufficient
anti_patterns.problem: Files with 3-8 interdependent errors need sequential fixing with validation
anti_patterns.example: File has: (1) docstring error, (2) import error from #1, (3) indentation error from #2
anti_patterns.mece_approach: All patterns applied in parallel in single pass
anti_patterns.required_approach: Pass 1: Fix docstrings + validate | Pass 2: Fix imports + validate | Pass 3: Fix indentation
anti_patterns.lesson: Complex syntax errors require multi-pass iterative repair with validation gates
anti_patterns.prevention: Design future protocols with multi-pass architecture and ast.parse() gates between passes

wave_10_success_metrics.method: Surgical precision - analyzed each error, applied minimal fix, validated immediately
success_factors: Manual ast.parse() validation after each edit

mece_failure_metrics.method: Parallel agent coordination with regex pattern matching
